scientific_integrity: Analytic proof independent of simulation; finite numerical checks corroborate only, and no external or independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact result concerns labelled geodesic cycles from uniform hemisphere vertices; for n>=4 cycles may self-intersect and are not convex hulls. The CLT is weak and the series is not evaluated in elementary constants. Historical priority remains provisional because some older cap-triangle full texts were unavailable.
title: Exact perimeter variance and a Gaussian cycle law for uniform hemisphere vertices
